svg.title: Prototype
svg.desc: Prototype. Create new objects by copying a configured prototype instead of building them from scratch, and know when a copy must go deep. Step 1, Set up from scratch: pdf(), email() and export() each repeat the same five setup calls, and export() has drifted. Step 2, Clone a ready prototype: registry.get('quarterly').clone() returns a new Report set up the same; only its title changes. Step 3, Shallow copy, shared trap: { ...quarterly } shares sections, so push('Forecast') gives both 4; clone() leaves quarterly at 3. Step 4, Deep copies and limits: structuredClone() copies deeply but returns a plain Object, so Report implements its own clone().

Java: Object.clone() needs Cloneable; Effective Java Item 13 advises care
Python: copy.copy() is shallow, copy.deepcopy() deep (it handles cycles)
At scale: Kubernetes pod templates, deployment stamps, machine images
